summary: Event Time Fields (start_time/end_time), Multi-day Events, and Time Format Settings testing complete. Backend: 11/11 tests passed after fixing time_format update bug. Frontend: All features verified working.

event_time_fields.details: Start Time and End Time fields present in event creation/edit form. Fields use HTML5 time input type. Data persists correctly to backend.

multiday_events.details: Multi-day Booking toggle works. Events with is_booking=true and end_date display correctly in calendar with '↔' indicator showing continuation across days. Duration shown in event cards (e.g., '3 days', '5 days').

calendar_time_display.details: Calendar displays event times. Time format respects company settings (12h shows '2:00 PM', 24h shows '14:00'). Events sorted by start_time.

time_format_settings.details: Settings > Preferences tab shows Time Format selector with options '24h (14:00)' and '12h (2:00 PM)'. Helper text explains 'Affects how times are displayed in calendars and events'. Save button persists changes.

time_format_api.details: GET /api/settings/company returns time_format field. PUT /api/settings/company accepts time_format updates (fixed bug: time_format was missing from allowed_fields).

test_event_verification.details: Test event 'Evento de Prueba con Horario' found with date range 1/15/2025 - 1/17/2025, start_time 14:00, end_time 22:00. Multi-day display working correctly.

bug_fixed.description: time_format field was not being saved in PUT /api/settings/company endpoint
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'time_format' to allowed_fields list in update_company_settings function

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed events during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Event time fields (start_time/end_time) and multi-day events fully implemented. Time format setting (12h/24h) in Settings > Preferences affects calendar display. Test event 'Evento de Prueba con Horario' exists with date 15-17 Jan 2025, time 14:00-22:00.

features: Start Date and End Date pickers
